description:
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {R}. Birgi, Blood Funnel and Prismari Pianist trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Prismari Pianist trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Blood Funnel trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature token.
Resolve the Searing Touch spell.
Repeat.

uses.name: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty
